groupDistance.basis: Every member sits at the cluster's Cosmicflows-4 group distance (table 3, DMzp), as the Nearby Universe places the members Cosmicflows-4 holds, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky: that the cluster is as deep as it is wide is an assumption, not a measurement of any member's depth.

sample: The 418 galaxies Kang et al.'s (2024) caustic analysis keeps as members of the Perseus cluster within 60 arcmin of its centre (table2, Mm = 1), less those within 10 arcsec of a Cosmicflows-4 galaxy, which the Nearby Universe field draws already: 391 kept.
meaning: Perseus Cluster member galaxies from the redshift survey of Kang et al. (2024) that the Nearby Universe field does not draw, one dot each at the cluster's Cosmicflows-4 group distance. Drawn when the cluster is selected.

toneBy.band: B from SDSS DR16 model g and r (CDS V/154, by the table's SDSS objID) through Jester et al. (2005, AJ 130, 873: B = g + 0.39 (g - r) + 0.21), not corrected for extinction
toneBy.basis: The Nearby Universe field's tone scale (its galaxies' recipe), so a member is as bright as a field galaxy of the same absolute magnitude: each galaxy's absolute B magnitude (its B magnitude minus the group's distance modulus) darkens its colour, from full at M_B -21.5 to 30% at -17.5, linear in magnitude; a member without a magnitude takes the faintest tone. Galactic extinction toward the cluster is not removed.

fullDetail.basis: Presentation choice: whole within 250 Mpc of the Sun, three times the cluster's distance, so every member shows while the cluster is selected and framed (the bank's origin is the Sun; the renderer's default of 10 kpc suits a galaxy's own dots).
